purpose: Compact GitHub-derived worker diagnostics for Control Room without write-heavy telemetry.

sections.coverage: Observed source counts and optional projection availability.
sections.useful_output: Evidence-backed productive units, visible change and durable RETURN completion.
sections.wasted_time: Observed collisions/no-allocation, beacon-without-claim, unresolved claims and first non-PASS stages.
sections.latency_proxies: Timestamp deltas only when both durable timestamps exist; otherwise unknown.
sections.stale_work: Uses explicit recovery/replaceable frontier evidence; wall-clock age alone never declares stale.

null_semantics: null means unavailable/unknown; it must never be rendered as numeric zero.
